hypotheses.title: Cash Flow Per Share Operating Elevation (Decay 5 Subindustry Target)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Firms generating exceptional quarterly cash flow per share relative to subindustry peers possess superior self-funded organic reinvestment capacity and pricing power. Subindustry neutralization removes sector-level cyclicality, and convex decile weighting isolates the top quintile of operating cash generators while eliminating turnover drag.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha returns invert or decay to Sharpe < 0.5 under extended 2-year backtest or market downturns.

hypotheses.title: FFO Operating Cash Margin Convexity in Industry Neutrality
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Funds from Operations (FFO) captures pure operating cash generation stripped of non-cash accruals and depreciation distortions. Evaluating FFO across broader industry peer groups distinguishes cash-flow compounders from capital-depleting competitors, producing robust Sharpe and well-distributed portfolio weights.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Negative returns during industry earnings announcement windows.

hypotheses.title: Operating Cash & Domestic EBIT Multiplicative Synergy
hypotheses.economic_rationale: A non-linear multiplicative cross-factor synergy (group_rank(A) * group_rank(B)) acts as a soft logical AND operator. Only corporations exhibiting both high funds from operations AND expanding domestic operating income receive top-tier portfolio weights, stripping away single-factor vulnerabilities and eliminating self-correlation collisions.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Loss of predictive power when domestic EBIT growth decouples from operating cash flow.
